transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Let's get this weekly sustainment review started. We've got used oil drums, vehicle batteries, expired medical cold packs, and empty compressed-air cylinders in the holding area, all awaiting disposition. Before I sign off on the disposition plan, I need updates from each of you. Environmental, what's the status on the oil drums and batteries? Maintenance, do we have anything on the cylinders? Medical logistics, what's the word on those expired cold packs? And transportation, do we have pickup or transfer schedules lined up for any of these items?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Good morning, Major. On the used oil drums, I confirmed this morning that we have exactly 18 drums of used oil, and the contracted recycling service has accepted them. Pickup is available on 26 June. I should note that the contractor confirmation is currently in the environmental file but has not yet been added to the S-4 disposition worksheet. I'll make sure that gets updated. As for the vehicle batteries, I don't have a confirmed disposition for those yet.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Major, on the vehicle batteries — I counted exactly 24 cases in the holding area. The approved battery vendor requires no more than 12 cases per pallet, so we need to ship them on exactly two pallets, both with battery-hazard labels. I've got the count and packing instruction documented in the motor-pool inspection folder, but I haven't sent it over to logistics yet. I'll get that over to you today so it can be included in the disposition plan.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Major, on the expired medical cold packs — I confirmed they must be returned to Medical Supply rather than discarded locally. The return appointment is set for 25 June. It's on the clinic supply calendar, but I should note it hasn't been cross-referenced with the holding-area disposition plan yet, so we need to make sure that gets tied in before you sign off.
